t: What Nanobots for Targeted Cancer Cell Destruction Is
title: What Nanobots for Targeted Cancer Cell Destruction Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Therapeutic nanobots are DNA-origami and nanoparticle machines that hunt cancer: navigating the bloodstream, recognizing tumor markers, and destroying malignant cells with drugs, heat, or mechanical action — surgery at the molecular scale. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Nanobots for Targeted Cancer Cell Destruction: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Nanobots for Targeted Cancer Cell Destruction in one line: Therapeutic nanobots are DNA-origami and nanoparticle machines that hunt cancer: navigating the bloodstream, recognizing tumor markers, and destroying malignant cells with drugs, heat, or mechanical action — surgery at the molecular scale.
Why it matters: They kill cancer cells and only cancer cells, sparing the patient..
Where it is used: solid tumors, metastases, residual disease, drug-resistant cancers..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
